LanguageData.LP_Genie.label: genie
LanguageData.LP_Genie.description: An elemental genie bound in a lamp. Genies are born with one of four elemental bloodlines: the efreeti of fire, the marid of water, the dao of earth and the djinni of air, with skin color and abilities following the bloodline. Rub the lamp and the genie appears to become your colonist, granting a wish every 60 days; when a genie falls it doesn't die but returns to the lamp to sleep for 15 days. If the lamp is sold, stolen or destroyed, the genie vanishes in smoke a day later.
LanguageData.LP_Genie.descriptionShort: Legendary race, not inheritable. Body size ×1.5, ageless, random elemental bloodline (ability cooldowns halved), one wish every 60 days; never truly dies, returns to the lamp when downed.
